records.text: NISR's 2025 Season A report identifies Nyagatare among the Eastern Province districts with the highest maize production. Table 14 reports 85,407 metric tonnes of maize for Nyagatare.
records.source_title: NISR Seasonal Agricultural Survey 2025 Season A, page 23 and Table 14 (page 37)
records.scope: Published district production context for Season A 2025. It is not a local model contribution and provides no evidence about storage capacity or methods. Do not multiply it by the app's unweighted profile-average loss rate to claim district tonnes lost.
